source.changes: Adapted the twelve stat blocks of issue #156 (Bugbear Warrior, Bulette, Camel, Cat, Centaur Trooper, Chain Devil, Chimera, Chuul, Clay Golem, Cloaker, Cloud Giant and Cockatrice; PDF pages 272–275 and 346) into typed mechanical fields and implementation keys. Trait, action, bonus action and reaction entries keep their source rules text, rejoined across line, column and page breaks; descriptive prose outside the stat blocks is omitted. A ranged attack printed with one range repeats it as its long range, and a hit printed without dice keeps explicit zero dice. No playable NPC behavior is granted.

If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object. Once the golem goes berserk, it continues to be berserk until it is destroyed or it is no longer Bloodied.

actions.name: Attach
actions.text: Attach. Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the cloaker attaches to it. While the cloaker is attached, the target has the Blinded condition, and the cloaker can’t make Attach attacks against other targets. In addition, the cloaker halves the damage it takes (round down), and the target takes the same amount of damage. The cloaker can detach itself by spending 5 feet of movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can take an action to try to detach the cloaker, doing so by succeeding on a DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check.
